title: fix(types,components,plugin-form): declare a form field's `step` (the spec's number) and `className`; built-in branches merge the class and derive the number step, ObjectForm stops writing 'any' (objectui#12130)
body:
Fixes #12130
Clause-②: yes (narrowing): declaring `step` and `className` widens the strict authoring face by two keys. Typing `step` as the spec's number narrows the tolerant face, from accepting `step: 'any'` (stripped) to refusing it at `fields[].step`.

Round 3 of objectui#12130 (`step`, `className`), the census's last two OPEN rows. After it the census ledger has no OPEN row. Implemented by the os-dev for the `domain:spec` @ objectui seat, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01V8qYZseSLfKH3V8tPu2f73`, claim 6113481475 as amended by 6114408150. Base `c0c2f79`, synced by merging `main` `f3d5408` (objectui#12155's DOM allowlist; conflicts kept both sides). Head `9c93615`.

## Premises (measured before any declaration): both held

- **`step`.** The built-in number input can derive the step from the metadata carrier (`field.field || field`; on the `ObjectForm` route that is the raw object field with `scale`), by `NumberField`'s rule: an explicit `step`, else `10^-scale`, else `any`. So `ObjectForm` now writes no `step`. `objectFormNumericStep-9574.test.tsx` passes on both routes with every assertion byte-identical to `main`: its 7 `expect(` lines diff empty, and only header prose changed. Ablating the derivation turns its two route-1 tests red. A hand-authored `input` with `inputType: 'number'` steps by `any` / `0.01` (scale 2) / `5` (explicit), where it had no step attribute / none / `5` before.
- **`className`.** Measured per type through the real `SchemaRenderer`, with components only and with `@object-ui/fields`, in three states. Every reader puts it on an element the field's own widget or branch renders: the control in most types, the widget's own box for `tags`, `file`, `image` and `slider`, the first sub-input for `address` and `geolocation`, a display element, or a `section-divider`'s divider. None puts it on the field row, the label, the host's read-only group or outside the row. `lookup`, `master_detail`, `user` and `signature` draw no class from it.

## What changed

- `packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`: the `input` and `default` arms derive a number input's step (`nativeNumberStep`), and the built-in branches merge an entry's `className` with their own classes (`cn(own, className)`), as `select` already did. Before, the entry's class replaced the touch-target and read-only classes.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx`: the `formField.step = … : 'any'` write is removed.
- `FormField` / `FormFieldSchema`: `step` declared by reference to the spec's `FieldSchema.step`; `className` declared as `string`.
- The census (both rows move to `DECLARED_BY_12130`), the effects and components-only pins (with/without cases, one per element class, and a never-the-row sweep), the face pin and the zod coverage list.
- Docs: `form.mdx` and `plugin-form.mdx` (`className` is now a declared key). Its pin in `check-doc-component-types.test.ts` flips to `toMatch`.
- Changesets: new `.changeset/12130-step-classname.md` (types / components `minor`, plugin-form `patch`, breaking semantics stated). Round 1's pending changeset loses its 「Still undeclared」 sentence.

## Gates run (code at `215da7e`; `9c93615` adds the `plugin-form/README.md` correction only)

- vitest under `os-verify-lock`: `scripts/__tests__/` 「Test Files 180 passed | 2 skipped (182)」; the 9574 pin 「Tests 3 passed (3)」; `examples/schema-catalog/` 「Test Files 46 passed (46)」. At `b1fd4c4`: `packages/types/`, `packages/plugin-form/`, `packages/components/`: all exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter` `type-check` for types, components, plugin-form and example-schema-catalog: exit 0. `pnpm check`: 「0 did not validate」.
- Doc gates over the rebuilt types (35 of 35 build tasks): `check-doc-component-types`, `-doc-snippet-types`, `-doc-json-fences`, `check:doc-fences`, `-doc-example-ids`: all exit 0.
- Changeset gates: `check-changeset-presence` 「7 source file(s) of 3 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)」. `-claims`, `-no-major`, `-overwrite` and `-fixed` exit 0 (`-overwrite` reports the round-1 changeset edit, report-only). `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes` and `check:new-line-citations` (「0 new citation(s)」): exit 0.
- Not measured here: the console bundle budget. CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/plugin-form/README.md` listed `className` as 「Not a `FormField` key」. It ships with the package, so it is corrected in this PR (`9c93615`, claim amendment `6114675131`): `className` moves to the declared keys and the stale 「23 keys」 count is dropped.
- `lookup`, `master_detail`, `user` and `signature` accept `className` and draw nothing from it. That is noted, not filed.
